capabilities: convert the active Markdown note to a themed HTML file
embed images as base64 or save them as separate asset files
choose the export theme, export folder, and image folder in settings
render wikilinks, embeds, tables, and task checkboxes in the output
hide frontmatter and handle missing images with a placeholder label
extras: README is written as a developer install/test guide (build with npm, Node.js prerequisite). Unsupported syntax: nested lists, callouts, and code block syntax highlighting. Exports folder is intended as a deploy root (e.g. Vercel). Unreviewed by Obsidian staff per manifest.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export a note as a standalone themed HTML page ready for publishing.
summary: Markdown-to-HTML exporter that converts the active note into a self-contained themed HTML file for hosting.
